domain: Mobile Multiplayer Poker Game (React Native Expo)

typography.headings: text-2xl to text-4xl, font-black, tracking-tight, uppercase for gaming feel

poker_table.shape: Oval via extreme border-radius (e.g., rounded-full) on a rectangular container where width > height.
poker_table.layout: Positioned centrally. Uses absolute positioning for player avatars around the perimeter of the table container.

bento_grids.lobby: Vertical stack of cards with tight gaps (gap-4). Dense data display for online players and active tables.
bento_grids.profile_selection: 2-column grid (grid-cols-2) for cartoon avatars, ensuring large tap targets for mobile.

avatar_card.style: bg-surface border border-surface_border rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden

action_buttons.container: flex-row justify-between gap-2 p-2 bg-surface/80 rounded-t-3xl

chip_badge.style: bg-black/60 rounded-full px-3 py-1 flex-row items-center border border-surface_border

avatars.description: Pre-seeded cartoon animal avatars for the 7 profiles (6 players + 1 admin)

textures.description: Background textures for the table (optional overlay)

chips.description: Casino chips for UI adornments or admin screen

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: This is a React Native Expo app. Do NOT use HTML tags (div, span, p). Use React Native components (View, Text, Image, TouchableOpacity, Pressable).
Use NativeWind for styling. Map the hex colors to tailwind config or use arbitrary values like bg-[#0a0f1a].

For the Poker Table layout: Create an outer wrapper View with landscape or portrait bounds. Inside, create an oval View for the table. Position the 6 player avatars using 'absolute' positioning around the table edges.
The Teal Glow on the table edge can be achieved using standard React Native shadows (shadowColor: '#00f0ff', shadowOffset, shadowOpacity, shadowRadius) or an Image background if performance allows.
For action buttons at the bottom: Group them in a container that sits at the bottom of the screen (absolute bottom-0 or flex-end).
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, avatar cards) have a data-testid attribute for testing (e.g., data-testid='profile-login-button').
Never use generic fonts like Inter. Setup custom fonts or use platform native bold sans-serif.
